tests.rival: KI-RO is merely a generic second-section marker with no numerical residual semantics.
tests.reason: The surviving KI-RO value 30 is exactly 100-70, while the erased 7 would have destroyed closure. Scribal correction is evidence about the intended numerical relation.
The 7 is explicitly marked erased in the critical-style commentary; treating 30[[7]] as 37 loses editorial state.
The scribe's erasure changes the value from a non-closing 37 to the unique closing complement 30. This is not just post-hoc equality.
